name: Z.ai free Flash models
amount: GLM-4.7-Flash, GLM-4.5-Flash and GLM-4.6V-Flash priced free (input and output); rate limits not published
summary: Z.ai prices its three Flash models at $0 on its international API. They're listed further down its pricing page (Text Models and Vision Models tables), not in the Latest Models table at the top, which only has paid GLM-5 models. There's no separate free plan: create an API key and call the model. GLM-4.5-Flash has an announced retirement. Z.ai's privacy policy says it uses data to improve its services, including training its models.
source_note: Z.ai pricing page and privacy policy, checked 2026-09-29. The weekly page check flags changes to the free list.
